questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?
7 × 3 - 98 ÷ 14 + 5 = 31
questions.solution:
Solution

Given equation: 7 × 3 - 98 ÷ 14 + 5 = 31

BODMAS Table:

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 5 and 3

Given: 7 × 3 - 98 ÷ 14 + 5 = 31

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 7 × 5 - 98 ÷ 14 + 3 = 31
⇒ 7 × 5 - 7 + 3 = 31
⇒ 35 - 7 + 3 = 31
⇒ 38 - 7 = 31
⇒ 31 = 31
⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) 31 and 7

Given: 7 × 3 - 98 ÷ 14 + 5 = 31

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 31 × 3 - 98 ÷ 14 + 5 = 7
⇒ 31 × 3 - 7 + 5 = 7
⇒ 93 - 7 + 5 = 7
⇒ 98 - 7 = 7
⇒ 91 ≠ 7
⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 3 and 14

Given: 7 × 3 - 98 ÷ 14 + 5 = 31

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 7 × 14 - 98 ÷ 3 + 5 = 31
⇒ 7 × 14 - 32.66 + 5 = 31
⇒ 98 - 32.66 + 5 = 31
⇒ 103 - 32.66 = 31
⇒ 70.34 ≠ 31
⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 7 and 98

Given: 7 × 3 - 98 ÷ 14 + 5 = 31

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 98 × 3 - 7 ÷ 14 + 5 = 31
⇒ 98 × 3 - 0.5 + 5 = 31
⇒ 294 - 0.5 + 5 = 31
⇒ 299 - 0.5 = 31
⇒ 298.5 ≠ 31
⇒ LHS ≠ RHS
Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

tags.conceptTested: Balancing equations via number interchange and strict adherence to the BODMAS rule.

questions.question: If 'A + B' means 'A is brother of B', 'A = B' means 'A is son of B', 'A & B' means 'A is wife of B', 'A @ B' means 'A is father of B', then how is N related to P given the expression: P = H = T & U @ N + R?
questions.solution:
As per the given data:
P = H means P is son of H.
H = T means H is son of T.
T & U means T is wife of U (so U is father and T is mother).
U @ N means U is father of N.
N + R means N is brother of R.

Tracing the lineage: P, H, and N are sons/children of T and U. Thus, N is the brother of P's father (H), which makes N the paternal uncle of P.
Hence, Option (C) is the answer.

questions.question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.
61, 63, 65, 77, 89, ?, 149, 205
questions.solution:
Solution

The logic followed here is:

The difference between two consecutive numbers is equal.

Hence, "119" is the correct answer.

Alternate Method
The logic follows here is:

61 + (1)2 + 1 = 61 + 2 = 63
63 + (2)2 - 2  = 63 + 2 = 65
65 + (3)2 + 3 = 65 + 12 = 77
77 + (4)2 - 4 = 77 + 12 = 89
89 + (5)2 + 5 = 89 + 30 = 119
119 + (6)2 - 6 = 119 + 30 = 149
149 + (7)2 + 7 = 149 + 56 = 205
Hence, the correct answer is "119".

questions.question: A stationery vendor buys pencils at the rate of 21 pencils for Rs. 20 and sells them at the rate of 20 pencils for Rs. 21. His profit percent is about:
questions.solution:
Solution

According to the given information:

A stationery vendor buys pencils at the rate of 21 pencils for Rs. 20 and sells them at the rate of 20 pencils for Rs. 21.

Given:
Cost Price of 21 pencils = Rs. 20
Selling Price of 20 pencils = Rs. 21
Selling Price of 1 pencil = Rs. 21 / 20 = Rs. 1.05
Selling Price of 21 pencils = 21 × 1.05 = 22.05
⇒ Profit = Selling price - Cost price
⇒ Profit = 22.05 - 20
⇒ Profit = 2.05
⇒ Profit% = (profit/cost price) × 100
⇒ Profit% = (2.05 / 20) × 100
⇒ Profit% = (0.1025) × 100
⇒ Profit% = 10.25

Thus, the profit percent is 10.25 ≈ 10.

Hence, the correct answer is "10".
